citations.quote: Name: Aurelion Sol. Official role tags: Mage.

Aurelion Sol flies over terrain in a targeted direction. While in this state, he can cast other abilities. Breath of Light no longer has a cooldown or maximum channel duration and deals increased damage while flying.

core_mechanics.summary: He can fly over terrain while using an enhanced Breath of Light.

purpose: Recognize his overall fighting pattern and damage focus.
title: Aurelion Sol

citations.quote: Aurelion Sol's damaging abilities against enemies generate him permanent stacks of Stardust, which gradually augments his abilities.

core_mechanics.summary: Damaging abilities generate permanent Stardust that improves his abilities.

citations.quote: Stardust increases Astral Flight's maximum range.
Stardust increases Singularity's area as well as the execution threshold.
Stardust increases the impact area of both Falling Star and The Skies Descend.

core_mechanics.summary: Stardust increases flight range, black-hole area and execute threshold, and ultimate impact area.

purpose: Recognize permanent scaling and growing threat areas.
title: Cosmic Creator

citations.quote: If the channel is cancelled within the first 0.25 seconds, Breath of Light is placed on a 1-second lockout but does not go on cooldown.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Very early cancellation can apply a brief lockout without starting the cooldown.

citations.quote: At rank 5, Breath of Light's channel duration is increased to 160 seconds.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Maximum rank greatly extends the channel duration.

citations.quote: Spell shield will only block the burst damage.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Spell shields block the burst rather than the continuous beam damage.

citations.quote: exhaling a beam in the target direction that continuously deals magic damage to the first enemy hit and reduced damage to other enemies. Aurelion Sol can steer the beam in any direction.

core_mechanics.summary: A steerable beam continuously damages its primary target and splashes reduced damage.

citations.quote: The beam will deal a burst of bonus magic damage for each full second that it damages the same enemy, and generates Stardust if the target is a champion.

core_mechanics.summary: Sustained contact triggers bonus bursts and generates Stardust against champions.

purpose: Recognize the beam and the danger of sustained contact.
title: Breath of Light

citations.quote: If a takedown is scored while Astral Flight is active, the cooldown will be reduced after it ends.

advanced_exceptions.summary: A takedown during flight applies its cooldown reduction after flight ends.

citations.quote: Aurelion Sol flies over terrain in a targeted direction. While in this state, he can cast other abilities.

core_mechanics.summary: Flight crosses terrain and permits ability casts.

citations.quote: During flight, he can cast any of his abilities, and Breath of Light has no cooldown, no maximum channel duration, and its flat damage is increased. Aurelion Sol flies at a reduced speed while channeling Breath of Light.

core_mechanics.summary: Flight enhances the beam and removes its cooldown and duration limit, while channeling reduces flight speed.

citations.quote: Aurelion Sol will be knocked down by any immobilizing crowd control during the dash.
Scoring a champion takedown within 3 seconds of damaging them refunds a large portion of Astral Flight's cooldown.

core_mechanics.summary: Immobilization stops flight; recent-damage champion takedowns greatly reduce its cooldown.

purpose: Recognize flight-enhanced beam pressure and its interruption window.
title: Astral Flight

citations.quote: Aurelion Sol conjures a black hole at the target location for a few seconds that continually deals magic damage to enemies within. Enemies in the black hole are dragged toward the center.

core_mechanics.summary: The black hole continuously damages enemies and pulls them inward.

citations.quote: Enemies within the center are executed below 5% (+ 2.6% per 100 Stardust) of their maximum health, excluding epic monsters.

core_mechanics.summary: The center executes low-health enemies except epic monsters.

purpose: Recognize the persistent pull zone and central execute.
title: Singularity

citations.quote: Aurelion Sol calls down a star that strikes the target location after 1.25 seconds, dealing magic damage to enemies hit and stunning them for 1 second.

core_mechanics.summary: A delayed star impact deals magic damage and stuns.

citations.quote: Once Falling Star has been learned, gathering 75 Stardust causes the next cast of Falling Star to transform into The Skies Descend, empowering the impact with new effects.

core_mechanics.summary: Gathering enough Stardust after learning the ultimate empowers its next cast.

purpose: Recognize the normal ultimate and its Stardust-based empowerment.
title: Falling Star

citations.quote: The shockwave radius and path are globally visible on the minimap.

advanced_exceptions.summary: The shockwave radius and path are globally visible on the minimap.

citations.quote: Aurelion Sol calls down a giant star that strikes the target location, dealing increased magic damage in a larger area and briefly knocking up enemies hit.

core_mechanics.summary: The empowered impact deals increased magic damage in a larger area and knocks up enemies.

citations.quote: Additionally, the impact sends a massive shockwave that rapidly expands from the area over 3 seconds, dealing magic damage to enemy champions and epic monsters hit, slowing all enemies hit by 50% for 1 second, and revealing them for 1.5 seconds.
Enemies hit by the star are immune to the shockwave.

core_mechanics.summary: An expanding shockwave slows and reveals enemies and damages champions and epic monsters; star-hit enemies are immune to it.

purpose: Recognize the empowered ultimate's larger knockup and outward shockwave.
title: The Skies Descend
